kernel.governing_law: Surplus is everywhere and costs nothing; the speaker moves through abundance as pure consumption without attachment — taking, discarding, rolling past, never held by any of it.
kernel.mutated_relation: The abundance that holds you — the finding that becomes mutual, the consumption that becomes nourishment, the passing-through that becomes dwelling.

independent.recovered_law: The relationship of chaotic, aggressive outward movement and excess (shooting, blasting past, blowing spots, looseness from intoxication) in Text A is transformed into intimate, inward gathering and domestic covenant (keeping, harboring, remaining at the hearth, being bound together by shared nourishment) in Text B.
independent.law_match_note: Both describe the same structural transformation: chaotic outward/passing-through movement becoming intimate inward dwelling, excess/consumption becoming nourishment, and transient encounter becoming mutual bond/covenant.
independent.terminal_note: The final lines maintain the inward, covenantal, domestic relation (being bound by hymn/pulse, nourished by a kept meal) rather than reverting to Text A's outward excess.
